remaining_doubts: 4512/4513 (10-to-15 transition brackets): 3393 (1/4-20 BHSCS) is attached as suggested hardware because it shares the merged '10 to 15' badge cell with 3320; it is really the hardware for the 10-series leg.
4332/4336 (15 + RT): the Ready Tube bolt assembly 3961 (RT-only badge) is recorded in notes, not in suggested_hardware, following the rule that only 15/F rows get attached.
12043/12044 cover caps: put in category 'accessory'; 'end_cap' would also fit. The text layer has a soft hyphen (U+00AD) before the em dash in the '—' cells; it was left out of the spec values.
Tap Profile End (ref. page 11-3) on 4-114 and 4-116 has no service number and no 15 badge, so it stays in notes and is not a machining_service part.
